workLog.detail: Read src/copilot-cli/skills/pr-autofix/SKILL.md in full (712 lines): lease mechanics (ADR-076), live-state gate (issue #2455), tier ladder T1-T5, and confirmed no existing round/time cap on the T3/T4 thread-fix loop

Located check_pr_live_state.py and pr_autofix_lease.py under .claude/skills/github/scripts/pr/ (mirrored byte-identical to src/copilot-cli/skills/github/scripts/pr/); confirmed pr_autofix_lease.py's ADR-076 hidden-marker-PR-comment storage pattern and reused it over commit counting (commits do not survive squash/rebase/force-push, all routine in this repo's pr-autofix flow)

Added check_pr_round_cap.py: records one round per call against a hidden marker PR comment, evaluates round-count (default 5) and wall-clock (default 4h) caps independently, returns a check_pr_live_state.py-style JSON envelope (Data.action=ACT|ESCALATE), posts a one-time human-readable escalation comment on ESCALATE. Mirrored byte-identical into src/copilot-cli/skills/github/scripts/pr/.

Wired the gate into src/copilot-cli/skills/pr-autofix/SKILL.md as Step 2.5 (T3/T4-scoped, immediately after tier is known), plus Workflow list item 5, a Scripts section example, and a Verification checklist row

Added tests/skills/pr-autofix/test_check_pr_round_cap.py: 26 tests covering build_parser defaults/env-var override, evaluate_round_cap (below cap, exactly at cap, wall-clock exceeded independent of round count, corrupted state tolerance), marker parse/render round-trip, and main() envelope shape/exit codes (0/1/3) including escalation-comment idempotency and non-fatal escalation-post failure

Ran check_skill_md_portability.py, check_skill_md_exec_portability.py, check_plugin_frontmatter_self_containment.py, check_skill_contract_tests.py against the modified SKILL.md; fixed an initial DRIFT (literal .agents/ paths cited in Step 2.5 prose were inside the pre-existing outer HTML comment, not a standalone vendor-portability marker, so the checker's regex did not recognize the declaration) by removing the literal upstream paths from prose entirely per plugin-self-containment.md's 'write shared agent prose without naming a tree-specific path' guidance
Created GitHub issue #5056 (label application to nonexistent 'pr-autofix' label failed, non-fatal; issue itself created) since no existing issue covered this circuit breaker
